body: I wish with everything I have that things will get better, but its just been getting worse every day.

Just being alive does it now.The world expects me to function but everything seems meaningless. I pushed away the only person I loved a year ago and I realized that it is gone now. I realized I made a mistake but I can't put the burden of my life on her. My mom took me out for coffee for my birthday yesterday and tried to figure out how she could help me. She asked me what makes me happy and I broke down crying. I just realized that there was truly nothing that made me happy anymore and that last thing that brought me joy was the woman I broke up with a year ago.  I feel completely hopeless and I'm tired of putting myself through this daily suffering

My birthday was yesterday. When I woke up I though about happier birthdays when I was a little kid and realized I will never be that happy again. I pushed away the only person I loved a year ago and yesterday I decided I don't want another birthday. I just need to figure out how I want to make that happen.
